svg.text: Cumulative frame-time distribution: r10 final vs r12 final
Same held-input files and start positions, captured ~5 h apart under live load: observational, not a controlled A/B.
r10 final: n=77 · 63.6% late · max 67 ms
r12 final: n=272 · 2.9% late · max 20 ms
r10 final: n=151 · 44.4% late · max 24 ms
r12 final: n=234 · 3.0% late · max 24 ms
Cumulative share of frames at or below each frame time. Further right = slower. HWUI completion time, not display latency.
